# Embeddings

> Embeddings builds retailer-owned AI shopping agents and the enriched product catalogues that power them.

**When to use:** Use these pages to understand Embeddings’ offer, process, company, privacy practices, or contact path.

**When not to use:** Do not treat this file as product inventory, live availability, legal advice, or a substitute for the linked pages.

**How to use:** Follow the canonical HTML links below and cite the page that supports each claim.

## Offer and process
- [Embeddings: AI Shopping Agents for Australian Retailers](https://embeddings.au): Understand the retailer-owned shopping agent offer, commercial context, proof, and services.
- [From Catalogue to Live Agent](https://embeddings.au/process): Review the Foundation, Deploy, and Operate phases from catalogue audit to a live agent.
## Company and trust
- [About Us](https://embeddings.au/about): Learn who Embeddings is, what the team builds, and the engineering focus behind the work.
- [Privacy](https://embeddings.au/privacy): Read how the marketing site and business enquiries handle personal information.
## Contact
- [Contact Us](https://embeddings.au/contact): Prepare a business enquiry about a product catalogue, commerce stack, and retailer-owned shopping agent.
